entry.author: Nelson City Council
entry.summary:
Cambria Street Walkway

Have you taken a stroll up this new walkway yet? Head to The Wood, and at the end of Cambria Street you’ll find a stairway that leads up to the Sit Stanley Whitehead track. 

From here you will get amazing panoramic views of Nelson and the Haven. 
Turn right at the top and continue on to the rest of the winding trails around the Centre of New Zealand and Botanics.

You’ll pass a few grazing sheep, see mature native trees, a glimpse of a historic house and many a Tui singing in the canopy. 

Pop Cambria Street steps on your next place to explore.
